title: Predict. Feel. Act.: From Learning Actions to Learning Physical Interaction
subtitle: Perspectives from the Nanjing forum: the research behind Omega-EVA, DECO, and SEET
summary: How can robots anticipate the consequences of their actions, understand physical contact, and keep a task moving as conditions change? Drawing on latent consequence feedback in Omega-EVA, tactile adaptation in DECO, and our ongoing SEET research, we examine physical interaction, long-horizon execution, and the data needed to improve them.
